content: It's now Day 5 — the pass should be open! The rock at (11,4) is gone from the map (only notice board remains). The exit is at the top-right (x 11, y 3). Let me head to the pass and up to the shrine chest at (11,1).

args.approach: Day 5 reached, rockslide cleared (rock gone). Walk to the east corridor exit at (11,3), go north to the shrine chest at (11,1), and open it with interact.
